# Heritage Institute

> A comprehensive resource analyzing how corporate interests shape democracy, government, education, and environmental policy across nations.

Heritage Institute publishes Sharon Beder's research on business-managed democracy, documenting corporate influence mechanisms through lobbying, media control, think tanks, and policy capture. The site provides critical analysis of neoliberal policies including privatization, trade liberalization, and commercialization of public institutions.

## Key Topics

- Business-Managed Democracy
- Corporate Influence
- Neoliberalism
- Privatization
- Education Policy
- Environmental Regulation
- Public Relations
- Think Tanks
- Trade Liberalization
- Media Control
- Greenwashing
- Political Systems
- Public Services
- Corporate Propaganda
- Education Reform

## Core Concepts

- [Business-Managed Democracy - Introduction](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/index.html): Introduction to Business-Managed Democracy by Sharon Beder at Heritage Institute
- [Business-Managed Government - Introduction](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/government/index.html): Overview of business-managed government and corporate influence on policy

## Government & Policy

- [Business-Managed Government - National Lobbying & Think Tanks](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/government/national/index.html): Analysis of corporate lobbying and think tanks influencing national government
- [Business-Managed Government - Media Control](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/government/media/index.html): Examination of media control and corporate influence on journalism
- [Business-Managed Government - International Coercion](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/government/international/index.html): Analysis of WTO and Washington Consensus impact on global governance
- [Business-Managed Government - Trade Policy](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/government/trade/index.html): History of GATT and trade liberalization policies favoring corporations
- [Business-Managed Government - Trade in Services](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/government/services/index.html): Analysis of GATS and service liberalization affecting public services
- [Business-Managed Government - Privatisation](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/government/privatisation/index.html): Study of privatization of public services and neoliberal business interests

## Education System

- [Business-Managed Democracy - Education Overview](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/index.html): Overview of corporate influence and commercialism in education systems
- [Business-Managed Democracy - Education Funding](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/funding/index.html): Analysis of school funding and corporate influence on education policy
- [Business-Managed Democracy - Commercialism in Education](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/commercialism/index.html): Study of advertising and marketing to children in schools and classrooms
- [Business-Managed Democracy - Sponsored Classroom Materials](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/sponsored/index.html): Examination of corporate-sponsored educational materials and curriculum bias
- [Business-Managed Education - Business Campaigns](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/campaigns/index.html): Analysis of Business Roundtable campaigns to influence school reform
- [Business-Managed Democracy - Schools as Businesses](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/businesses/index.html): Critique of business model application to schools and privatization
- [Business-Managed Democracy - Standardised Testing](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/curricula/index.html): Analysis of standardized testing and business influence on curriculum
- [Business-Managed Democracy - School Choice](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/choice/index.html): Examination of school choice policies and education marketization
- [Business-Managed Democracy - Privatising Schools](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/education/privatising/index.html): Study of school privatization and for-profit education models

## Environmental Policy

- [Business-Managed Democracy - Environment Overview](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/environment/index.html): Overview of corporate influence on environmental policy and regulation
- [Business-Managed Environment - Front Groups](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/environment/fronts/index.html): Analysis of astroturf groups and grassroots manufacturing by corporations
- [Business-Managed Environment - Public Relations](http://www.herinst.org/BusinessManagedDemocracy/environment/PR/index.html): Examination of greenwashing and corporate environmental propaganda
